steps.title: Confirm the target job and your starting point
steps.action: Ask whether the vacancy is still open, which credentials are mandatory before starting, which are preferred, and whether paid training or a trainee route exists. Confirm credentials you already hold before paying for a course.

steps.title: Apply to the selected job once requirements are confirmed
steps.action: Confirm the full requirements and vacancy, then apply when ready. A preferred credential alone should not force you to wait for a course before applying.

steps.title: Check requirements before choosing a course
steps.action: No credential pathway was identified from the supplied evidence. Read the full posting with the employer; do not assume no certification is required or buy a generic course.

steps.title: Apply for interim work while preparing
steps.action: Review the displayed interim options. Confirm required credentials, other qualifications, current openings, shifts, and pay before applying. If there are no suitable options, ask a local job center for a search with fewer entry barriers.

links.label: Find an American Job Center; ask about training funding and employment support

steps.title: Fit an interim offer around training
steps.action: Compare actual offered shifts with training sessions, travel, and assessment dates. Ask about part-time, evening, or employer-supported training options. Neither schedule compatibility nor a job start is assumed.

steps.title: Review the target-job transition
steps.action: Check which credentials and experience requirements are actually met and whether the target opening is still available. Apply or ask about the next step when appropriate; continue interim work and the training pathway if more time is needed.

notes: This is a 30-day action window, not a promise of certification, placement, or funding.
